Maya (PM): Quick sync — dedicated capacity roadmap Q3/Q4. Need decisions: reserve-pool sizing strategy, quota enforcement (soft vs hard), burst admission rules, and autoscale cooldowns. Customers want predictable bursts; ops wants strict headroom controls.
Tom (Eng): Agree. My suggestion: pilot a 'slot buckets' model. Tenants buy N slots. Each concurrent request consumes 1 slot; slots auto-refill daily. Start with 3 customers on pilot.
Priya (Eng-Platform): We should be explicit about autoscale cooldown and prewarm triggers. Draft: cooldown=120s, prewarm when 90th pct queue > 30s for 2m. Also need a predictive signal from historical 1h/24h patterns.
Carlos (SRE): +1 but caution on preemption storms. If we preempt too fast we'll see 503 spikes. Add a circuit breaker: if preempt_rate > 5% over 5m, suspend preemptions for 10m.
Jenny (Sales): Sales feedback: enterprise buyers want a "burst SLA" doc and transparent billing. Preference leans toward soft quotas with paid surge rather than hard cutoffs.
Maya (PM): Those are the tradeoffs. Hard quotas simplify infra; soft quotas enable commercial flexibility. Let's draft concrete launch criteria.
Maya (PM): Launch criteria (draft):
- P95 generation latency within dedicated pool < 300ms under nominal load
- Paid burst admission success >= 99%
- Preemption rate <= 2% during normal operations
- Billing integrity: metered burst usage within 1% vs recorded
- SRE runbook + rollback playbook published
- Two customers in pilot for >= 4 weeks with no major regressions
Metrics to track: latency by tenant, preempt count, queue length, headroom, cost per token.
Tom (Eng): For the experiment, feature-flag gated rollout + A/B: 50% traffic to reserve-slot model vs baseline. We'll need telemetry tags and tenant-scoped metrics.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Config prototype for gating and policy: 
```
capacity_policy:
  mode: soft_quota
  burst_price_multiplier: 3.0
  cooldown_seconds: 120
  prewarm_threshold: 0.9
```
We'll iterate after pilot telemetry.
Carlos (SRE): Also require fallback routing: when dedicated pool is saturated, route to hosted-compatible model variant with lower SLA instead of dropping requests. That will reduce customer-visible errors.
Maya (PM): Action items: @Tom build pilot infra + feature flag; @Priya implement autoscale + prewarm hooks and dashboards; @Carlos craft runbook and circuit-breaker thresholds; @Jenny prepare pilot contract language and billing examples. Sync in 48h to align scope.
Tom (Eng): Ack — starting infra work. ETA for MVP infra: 2 weeks.
Priya (Eng-Platform): I'll add dashboards in 1 week and prewarm code in 2 weeks.
Carlos (SRE): Drafting runbook now, will include rollback and oncall playbook.
Jenny (Sales): I'll target two customers and share proposed pilot pricing. Need final price multiplier guidance from PM.
Maya (PM): I'll post a short PRD later today with the decision matrix and risk/mitigations. :rocket:
DeployBot: feature-flag created: reserve_slots_v1 (flags: off for prod, on for pilot tenants).
Maya (PM): Thanks all — prioritize telemetry tags and billing hooks first. We'll reconvene after initial telemetry flows in. :+1:
